title: Active Components of Wen Fei Fu Yang Qu Tan Fang and its Molecular Targets for Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease Based on Network Pharmacology and Molecular Docking.
authors: Feng, Yangrong; Zhang, Wei; Bao, Sanyu; Shen, Jieru
one_liner_zh: 该文基于网络药理学和分子对接研究中药复方治疗慢阻肺的活性成分与靶点，虽涉及分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: To investigate the mechanism of Wen Fei Fu Yang Qu Tan Fang (WFFYQTF) in the treatment of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) using network pharmacology and pharmacodynamics. The TCMSP database was utilized to identify the chemical components and molecular targets of WFFYQTF. Cytoscape software was employed to construct a "drug component-target" network. COPD risk genes and intersecting molecular targets of WFFYQTF were identified using GeneCards, OMIM, and DisGeNET databases. The STRING website was the place where protein-protein interaction (PPI) analysis was performed. Cytoscape topological analysis was applied for screening out key targets of WFFYQTF. GO and KEGG enrichment analyses were conducted using the DAVID database to elucidate the treatment targets of COPD with WFFYQTF. A total of 136 active components of WFFYQTF were identified, including key components such as quercetin, kaempferol, and luteolin, which were found to be particularly significant. Additionally, 412 drug targets and 7121 COPD risk genes were screened out, and 323 treatment targets of COPD with WFFYQTF were determined by Wayne analysis. Core targets identified via PPI analysis included SRC, STAT3, AKT1, HSP90AA1, and JUN. Pathways such as the hypoxia responce, inflammatory response, PI3K/AKT pathway, TH17 pathway and MAPK pathway were obtained with GO and KEGG enrichment analyses. Molecular docking results suggested that quercetin could be soundly bound to STAT3 and AKT1, and kaempferol to SRC. WFFYQTF can effectively impede COPD progression through the coordinated action of multiple components, targets, and pathways during treatment.
abstract_zh: 为了运用网络药理学和药效动力学探讨温肺扶阳祛痰方（WFFYQTF）治疗慢性阻塞性肺疾病（COPD）的作用机制。利用TCMSP数据库识别WFFYQTF的化学成分和分子靶点。采用Cytoscape软件构建“药物成分-靶点”网络。通过GeneCards、OMIM和DisGeNET数据库识别COPD风险基因及WFFYQTF的交叉分子靶点。STRING网站用于进行蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）分析。应用Cytoscape拓扑分析筛选WFFYQTF的关键靶点。使用DAVID数据库进行GO和KEGG富集分析，以阐明WFFYQTF治疗COPD的靶点。共鉴定出WFFYQTF的136种活性成分，包括槲皮素、山柰酚和木犀草素等关键成分，这些成分尤为重要。此外，筛选出412个药物靶点和7121个COPD风险基因，并通过韦恩分析确定了323个WFFYQTF治疗COPD的靶点。通过PPI分析识别的核心靶点包括SRC、STAT3、AKT1、HSP90AA1和JUN。通过GO和KEGG富集分析获得了缺氧反应、炎症反应、PI3K/AKT通路、TH17通路和MAPK通路等通路。分子对接结果表明，槲皮素能与STAT3和AKT1良好结合，山柰酚能与SRC良好结合。WFFYQTF通过多成分、多靶点和多通路的协同作用，能有效抑制COPD的进展。
